# Closed-Loop Null-Space Exploration

## Status

Evidence class: derived, provisional specification. This chapter records the
mathematical specification delivered by NSX-00 (#12549) and the deferred
external-validation protocol from NSX-05 (#12554) under epic #12593 so the
pathway can be inventoried as child modules land. It is not approved. The
registry blocker `UP-NSX-loop-nullspace-exploration` stays open until UP-D1
inventories the complete calculation pathway and a human reviews it.

## Purpose

Characterize the affine family of joint torques, internal hand-on-club closure
wrenches, and ground-reaction forces consistent with an admitted two-handed golf
swing trajectory across all modeling engines, separating model-determined
invariants from hypothesis-conditioned feasible envelopes:

- the general equality allocation system $A x = b$ and its four structural
  dimensions (equality nullity, multiplier gauge, attainable torque variation,
  and inequality-bounded feasible dimension);
- the three-case diagnostic for zero-side limb solves (`CONSISTENT_UNIQUE`,
  `CONSISTENT_NONUNIQUE`, `INCONSISTENT`);
- the exact $6 \times 6$ grasp-map kernel at the canonical grip midpoint frame
  and the bare-club Newton–Euler resultant with welded hand solids removed;
- the six allocation-invariant quantities and their scaled residual validity
  gates;
- static and trajectory-coupled feasible envelopes, Chebyshev margins, and
  prior-conditioned conic allocations.

## Conventions

- Sign (binding, ADR-0052 and ADR-0054): every hand wrench is the loading
  **exerted by the hand on the bare club**; in the tree equation of motion,
  $+J_c^\top \lambda$ acts on the human kinematic tree and $-\lambda$ acts on the
  closing hand interface.
- Canonical grip-midpoint frame (`C-FRAME-GRIP`): origin at
  $r_M = \tfrac{1}{2}(r_L + r_R)$, $\hat{u}$ along the shaft from grip toward
  clubhead, $\hat{v}$ along the clubface normal projection orthogonal to
  $\hat{u}$, and $\hat{w} = \hat{u} \times \hat{v}$, with row order
  `[fx, fy, fz, tx, ty, tz]`.
- Every numeric output is a `QuantityRecord` carrying six evidence axes:
  `allocation_dependence`, `model_provenance`, `input_provenance`,
  `conventions`, `hypotheses`, and `validation_status`.

## Equations

1. General allocation equality (R2):
   $$A x = b, \qquad A = \begin{bmatrix} S^\top & J_c^\top & J_g^\top \end{bmatrix}, \qquad x = \begin{bmatrix} \tau \\ \lambda \\ f_g \end{bmatrix}, \qquad b = M(q)a + h(q, v)$$
2. Four dimension counts (R2):
   $$\nu_{\text{eq}} = \dim x - \operatorname{rank} A, \qquad \nu_{\text{gauge}} = m_c - \operatorname{rank} J_c, \qquad \nu_\tau = \operatorname{rank}(J_c^\top) - \operatorname{rank}(J_{c,u}^\top)$$
3. Zero-side minimum-residual diagnostic (R3):
   $$\rho_s = \left\lVert \left(I - J_s^\top (J_s^\top)^+\right)\tau_{\text{ID},s} \right\rVert_2$$
4. Bare-club mass partition (`full_body_spec_anthro_driver.json`, R4 / NSX-01):
   $$m_{\text{club}}^{\text{bare}} = 0.198 + 0.065 + 0.050 = 0.313\,\mathrm{kg}, \qquad m_{\text{hands}}^{\text{welded}} = 0.5491 + 0.010 + 0.5491 = 1.1082\,\mathrm{kg}$$
5. Grasp-map $6 \times 6$ split coordinates at $r_M$ with $\mathbf{r}_{R,L} - \mathbf{r}_M = \pm h\hat{u}$ (R4):
   $$F_{L,R} = \tfrac{1}{2}F_{\text{net}} \mp s_f, \qquad \tau_{L,R} = \tfrac{1}{2}M_M - h(\hat{u} \times s_f) \mp s_m$$
   with exact inverse $s_f = \tfrac{1}{2}(F_R - F_L)$ and
   $s_m = \tfrac{1}{2}(\tau_R - \tau_L)$.
6. Asymmetric gross-power identity on $J_c v = 0$ (R6):
   $$\sum_i \left(c_+[p_i]_+ + c_-[-p_i]_+\right) = \tfrac{1}{2}(c_+ + c_-)\sum_i |p_i| + \tfrac{1}{2}(c_+ - c_-)P_{\text{net}}$$
7. Constrained KKT operational projector for ZTCF/ZVCF (R9):
   $$P_{\text{KKT}} = M^{-1}\left(I - J_c^\top (J_c M^{-1} J_c^\top)^{-1} J_c M^{-1}\right)$$

## Unavailable Values

- Any invariant whose kinematic or contact admission gate ($\Phi$, $\dot{\Phi}$,
  $\ddot{\Phi}$, or stance-foot slip) exceeds its scaled threshold is emitted as
  `UNAVAILABLE(reason)` with `NaN` values, never approximated.
- Any envelope direction that is unbounded or unobservable under the declared
  hypothesis set is recorded as `NaN` with status `UNBOUNDED`.
- If the `highspy` or `clarabel` solver backend is absent, envelope and conic
  allocation routines return `UNAVAILABLE(reason="solver_unavailable")`.

## Assumptions and Limitations

- Invariance (`INVARIANT`) means algebraically constant across the null space of
  $A x = b$ for a fixed multibody model and admitted trajectory; it does not
  mean empirically measured.
- No unique hand split is identifiable from motion capture alone; all split
  coordinates $s_1 \dots s_6$ and loop joint torques are `FAMILY_DEPENDENT`.
- Net joint torques carry no information about antagonist muscle co-contraction
  or joint stiffness.
- External validation against instrumented golf grips and synchronized surface
  EMG remains open and deferred under `DV-12554`.
